import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch, Polygon
from matplotlib.path import Path
import numpy as np
import json
import os

# ── Load data ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
with open('/app/benchmark/source_data.json') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

# ── Figure ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(36, 24), dpi=150, facecolor='#FAFBFC')
ax = fig.add_axes([0.03, 0.03, 0.94, 0.94])
ax.set_xlim(0, 1)
ax.set_ylim(0, 1)
ax.axis('off')

# ── Color palette — engineering-focused, data-dense ────────────────────────
C_SVC      = '#1B4F72'   # dark navy
C_SVC_LIT  = '#D4E6F1'
C_KAFKA    = '#0E6251'   # deep teal
C_KAFKA_LIT= '#D1F2EB'
C_DLQ      = '#922B21'   # dark red
C_DLQ_LIT  = '#FADBD8'
C_SCHEMA   = '#6C3483'   # purple
C_SCHEMA_LIT='#E8DAEF'
C_PROM     = '#D35400'   # orange
C_GRAF     = '#2471A3'   # steel blue
C_ALERT    = '#B03A2E'   # red
C_PDUTY    = '#7B241C'   # dark red
C_SLACK    = '#1E8449'   # green

C_PRODUCE  = '#5D6D7E'
C_CONSUME  = '#2874A6'
C_DLQ_EDGE = '#E74C3C'
C_SCHEMA_E = '#A569BD'
C_MON_E    = '#ABB2B9'
C_BG       = '#FAFBFC'

# ── Drawing helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def draw_box(ax, x, y, w, h, fc, ec, lw=2.0, ls='-', z=5, rpad=0.05):
    box = FancyBboxPatch((x-w/2, y-h/2), w, h,
                         boxstyle=f"round,pad={rpad}", facecolor=fc,
                         edgecolor=ec, linewidth=lw, linestyle=ls, zorder=z)
    ax.add_patch(box)

def edge(ax, x1, y1, x2, y2, color, lw=1.0, alpha=0.5, ls='-', z=1, curve=0.0):
    """Draw an edge with an arrowhead."""
    if abs(curve) < 0.001:
        verts, codes = [(x1,y1),(x2,y2)], [Path.MOVETO, Path.LINETO]
    else:
        midx, midy = (x1+x2)/2, (y1+y2)/2
        dy = abs(y2-y1)
        cpx = midx + curve*dy
        cpy = midy - abs(curve)*dy*0.3 + curve*dy*0.6
        verts, codes = [(x1,y1),(cpx,cpy),(x2,y2)], [Path.MOVETO, Path.CURVE3, Path.CURVE3]
    path = Path(verts, codes)
    ax.add_patch(mpatches.PathPatch(path, edgecolor=color, facecolor='none',
                                     lw=lw, linestyle=ls, alpha=alpha, zorder=z))
    dx, dy = x2-x1, y2-y1
    d = np.hypot(dx, dy)
    if d < 0.001: return
    ux, uy = dx/d, dy/d
    tip = 0.01
    arr = Polygon([[x2-ux*0.025, y2-uy*0.025],
                   [x2-ux*0.038-uy*tip*0.5, y2-uy*0.038+ux*tip*0.5],
                   [x2-ux*0.038+uy*tip*0.5, y2-uy*0.038-ux*tip*0.5]],
                  facecolor=color, edgecolor='none', alpha=alpha, zorder=z)
    ax.add_patch(arr)

# ── Layout coordinates ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 6-column grid for services
svc_cols = {}
svc_list = ['svc-order', 'svc-payment', 'svc-inventory', 'svc-shipping', 'svc-notification', 'svc-analytics']
for i, sid in enumerate(svc_list):
    svc_cols[sid] = 0.07 + i * 0.172

# Two service rows — producers above Kafka, consumers below
svc_y_top = 0.895   # producer row
svc_y_bot = 0.605   # consumer row

# Which services appear in which row
prod_row = {'svc-order', 'svc-payment', 'svc-inventory', 'svc-shipping'}
cons_row = {'svc-payment', 'svc-inventory', 'svc-shipping', 'svc-notification', 'svc-analytics'}

# Kafka topics — row between the two service rows
topic_y = 0.76
topic_map = {}
topic_order = ['orders.created','orders.updated','payments.completed','payments.failed',
               'inventory.reserved','inventory.released','shipping.dispatched']
for i, tn in enumerate(topic_order):
    topic_map[tn] = 0.08 + i * 0.12

# DLQ topics
dlq_y = 0.44
dlq_map = {
    'dlq.payments':     0.242,
    'dlq.inventory':    0.414,
    'dlq.shipping':     0.586,
    'dlq.notification': 0.758,
}

# Schema Registry
sch_x, sch_y = 0.5, 1.09

# Monitoring chain
mon_y = 0.22
mon_chain = [
    ('Prometheus',    C_PROM,  '[P]',  0.065),
    ('Grafana',       C_GRAF,  '[G]',  0.22),
    ('Alertmanager',  C_ALERT, '[AM]', 0.39),
    ('PagerDuty',     C_PDUTY, '[PD]', 0.56),
    ('Slack\n#alerts',C_SLACK, '[#]',  0.73),
]
mon_pos = {}

# ── Zone backgrounds ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
for x0,y0,x1,y1,c,a in [
    (0.005, svc_y_top-0.055, 0.995, svc_y_top+0.06,  C_SVC,    0.04),
    (0.005, topic_y-0.045,   0.995, topic_y+0.045,    C_KAFKA,  0.07),
    (0.005, svc_y_bot-0.06,  0.995, svc_y_bot+0.06,   C_CONSUME,0.03),
    (0.005, dlq_y-0.04,      0.995, dlq_y+0.045,      C_DLQ,    0.04),
    (0.005, mon_y-0.035,     0.995, mon_y+0.04,       C_PROM,   0.02),
]:
    draw_box(ax, (x0+x1)/2, (y0+y1)/2, x1-x0, y1-y0, c, c, lw=0.5, alpha=c if False else 1, z=0)
    # Use a simpler approach
    rect = FancyBboxPatch((x0,y0), x1-x0, y1-y0, boxstyle="round,pad=0.005",
                          facecolor=c, edgecolor=c, linewidth=0.5, alpha=a, zorder=0)
    ax.add_patch(rect)

# ── Section labels ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
lbl_opts = dict(fontsize=8.5, fontweight='bold', fontfamily='monospace', zorder=15, alpha=0.85)
ax.text(0.008, topic_y,        'KAFKA\nTOPICS',      ha='center', va='center', color=C_KAFKA, **lbl_opts)
ax.text(0.008, svc_y_top,      'PRODUCER\nSERVICES', ha='center', va='center', color=C_SVC,   **lbl_opts)
ax.text(0.008, svc_y_bot,      'CONSUMER\nSERVICES', ha='center', va='center', color=C_CONSUME,**lbl_opts)
ax.text(0.008, dlq_y,          'DEAD\nLETTER\nQ',    ha='center', va='center', color=C_DLQ,   **lbl_opts)
ax.text(0.008, mon_y,          'MONITORING\n& ALERTING', ha='center', va='center', color=C_PROM, **lbl_opts)
ax.text(sch_x, 1.135, 'Schema Registry', ha='center', va='center', fontsize=8.5,
        fontweight='bold', color=C_SCHEMA, fontfamily='monospace', alpha=0.85, zorder=15)

# ── Title ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ax.text(0.5, 1.175, 'Event-Driven Architecture — Complete Message Flow Panorama',
        ha='center', va='center', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', color='#17202A',
        fontfamily='monospace', zorder=20)
subtitle = ('Kafka-based Microservice Communication  |  Schema Registry Avro Validation  |  '
            'Dead Letter Queues & Retry  |  Prometheus → Grafana → Alertmanager → PagerDuty / Slack')
ax.text(0.5, 1.14, subtitle, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=6.5,
        fontstyle='italic', color='#5D6D7E', fontfamily='monospace', zorder=20)

# ── Draw Schema Registry ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
draw_box(ax, sch_x, sch_y, 0.17, 0.045, C_SCHEMA_LIT, C_SCHEMA, lw=2.8, rpad=0.06)
ax.text(sch_x, sch_y, 'Schema Registry  Avro', ha='center', va='center',
        fontsize=8, fontweight='bold', color=C_SCHEMA, fontfamily='monospace', zorder=10)

# ── Draw producer services ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
services = {s['id']: s for s in data['microservices']['data']}
for sid in prod_row:
    s = services[sid]
    x = svc_cols[sid]
    y = svc_y_top
    draw_box(ax, x, y, 0.155, 0.058, C_SVC_LIT, C_SVC, lw=2.3)
    ax.text(x, y+0.01, s['name'], ha='center', va='center', fontsize=8.5,
            fontweight='bold', color=C_SVC, fontfamily='monospace', zorder=10)
    role = 'PRODUCER' if s['role']=='producer' else 'PROD+CONS'
    rc = '#1A7A3A' if s['role']=='producer' else C_CONSUME
    ax.text(x, y-0.017, role, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=5.5,
            fontweight='bold', color=rc, fontfamily='monospace', zorder=10)

# ── Draw consumer services ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
for sid in cons_row:
    s = services[sid]
    x = svc_cols[sid]
    y = svc_y_bot
    draw_box(ax, x, y, 0.155, 0.058, C_SVC_LIT, C_CONSUME, lw=2.3)
    ax.text(x, y+0.01, s['name'], ha='center', va='center', fontsize=7.8,
            fontweight='bold', color=C_SVC, fontfamily='monospace', zorder=10)
    role = 'CONSUMER' if s['role']=='consumer' else 'PROD+CONS'
    ax.text(x, y-0.017, role, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=5.5,
            fontweight='bold', color=C_CONSUME, fontfamily='monospace', zorder=10)

# ── Draw Kafka topics ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
topics_data = {t['topic_name']: t for t in data['kafka_topics']['data']}
for tn, x in topic_map.items():
    t = topics_data[tn]
    draw_box(ax, x, topic_y, 0.108, 0.046, C_KAFKA_LIT, C_KAFKA, lw=2.8)
    short = tn.replace('.', '.\n', 1) if '.' in tn else tn
    ax.text(x, topic_y+0.007, short, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=6.5,
            fontweight='bold', color=C_KAFKA, fontfamily='monospace', zorder=10)
    tp = f"{t['peak_throughput_msg_sec']}"
    ax.text(x, topic_y-0.015, f'p={t["partitions"]} · {tp}/s', ha='center', va='center',
            fontsize=4.5, color='#508A78', fontfamily='monospace', zorder=10)

# ── Draw DLQ topics ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
for tn, x in dlq_map.items():
    t = topics_data[tn]
    draw_box(ax, x, dlq_y, 0.14, 0.04, C_DLQ_LIT, C_DLQ, lw=2.2, ls='--', rpad=0.04)
    short = tn.replace('dlq.', 'DLQ\n')
    ax.text(x, dlq_y, short, ha='center', va='center', fontsize=6,
            fontweight='bold', color=C_DLQ, fontfamily='monospace', zorder=10)

# ── Draw monitoring components ─────────────────────────────────────────────
for name, color, icon, mx in mon_chain:
    draw_box(ax, mx, mon_y, 0.12, 0.036, 'white', color, lw=2.2, rpad=0.04)
    ax.text(mx, mon_y, f'{icon} {name}', ha='center', va='center', fontsize=6,
            fontweight='bold', color=color, fontfamily='monospace', zorder=10)
    mon_pos[name] = (mx, mon_y)

# Monitor chain arrows
for i in range(len(mon_chain)-1):
    n1, c1, _, x1 = mon_chain[i]
    n2, c2, _, x2 = mon_chain[i+1]
    edge(ax, x1+0.065, mon_y, x2-0.065, mon_y, color=c1, lw=2.0, alpha=0.55, z=3)

# ── Event flow edges ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Map service ids to x and row
svc_pos = {}
for sid in prod_row:
    svc_pos[sid] = ('top', svc_cols[sid], svc_y_top)
for sid in cons_row:
    svc_pos[sid] = ('bot', svc_cols[sid], svc_y_bot)

# Build edge routing data
flows = data['event_flows']['data']

for flow in flows:
    src, tgt, ftype = flow['source'], flow['target'], flow['flow_type']

    if ftype == 'produce':
        if src in prod_row and tgt in topic_map:
            edge(ax, svc_cols[src], svc_y_top-0.032, topic_map[tgt], topic_y+0.024,
                 C_PRODUCE, lw=1.4, alpha=0.5, z=1)

    elif ftype == 'consume':
        if src in topic_map and tgt in cons_row:
            edge(ax, topic_map[src], topic_y-0.024, svc_cols[tgt], svc_y_bot+0.032,
                 C_CONSUME, lw=1.2, alpha=0.45, z=1)

    elif ftype == 'dlq-produce':
        if src in svc_cols and tgt in dlq_map:
            # Find if src is in top or bot row (or both)
            if src in cons_row:
                sy = svc_y_bot
            else:
                sy = svc_y_top
            edge(ax, svc_cols[src], sy-0.032, dlq_map[tgt], dlq_y+0.02,
                 C_DLQ_EDGE, lw=1.8, alpha=0.7, ls='dashed', z=2, curve=0.1)

    elif ftype == 'schema-lookup':
        if src in svc_cols:
            if src in prod_row:
                sy = svc_y_top
            else:
                sy = svc_y_bot
            dx = sch_x - svc_cols[src]
            edge(ax, svc_cols[src], sy+0.032, sch_x, sch_y-0.023,
                 C_SCHEMA_E, lw=1.0, alpha=0.5, ls='dotted', z=1, curve=-dx*0.12)

# ── Monitoring edges (representative) ──────────────────────────────────────
pmx, pmy = mon_pos['Prometheus']
for sid in svc_list:
    x = svc_cols[sid]
    if sid in prod_row:
        sy = svc_y_top
    else:
        sy = svc_y_bot
    edge(ax, x, sy-0.03, pmx, pmy+0.02, C_MON_E, lw=0.5, alpha=0.2, ls='dotted', z=0)

# Kafka cluster → Prometheus
edge(ax, topic_map['orders.created']-0.02, topic_y-0.024, pmx, pmy+0.02,
     C_MON_E, lw=0.5, alpha=0.25, ls='dotted', z=0)
edge(ax, 0.5, topic_y-0.024, pmx, pmy+0.02,
     C_MON_E, lw=0.5, alpha=0.25, ls='dotted', z=0)

# Schema Registry → Prometheus
edge(ax, sch_x, sch_y-0.023, pmx, pmy+0.02, C_MON_E, lw=0.5, alpha=0.22, ls='dotted', z=0)

# ── Retry policy annotations ───────────────────────────────────────────────
retry_data = data['retry_policies']['data']
for r in retry_data:
    sid = r['service_id']
    if sid in cons_row and r['strategy'] != 'none':
        x = svc_cols[sid]
        y = svc_y_bot - 0.055
        strat = f"{r['strategy']}  retries≤{r['max_retries']}  jitter={r['jitter']}"
        ax.text(x, y, strat, ha='center', va='top', fontsize=4.8, color=C_DLQ,

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch, Polygon
from matplotlib.path import Path
import numpy as np
import json
import os

# ── Load data ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
with open('/app/benchmark/source_data.json') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

# ── Figure ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(36, 24), dpi=150, facecolor='#FAFBFC')
ax = fig.add_axes([0.03, 0.03, 0.94, 0.94])
ax.set_xlim(0, 1)
ax.set_ylim(0, 1)
ax.axis('off')

# ── Color palette — engineering-focused, data-dense ────────────────────────
C_SVC      = '#1B4F72'   # dark navy
C_SVC_LIT  = '#D4E6F1'
C_KAFKA    = '#0E6251'   # deep teal
C_KAFKA_LIT= '#D1F2EB'
C_DLQ      = '#922B21'   # dark red
C_DLQ_LIT  = '#FADBD8'
C_SCHEMA   = '#6C3483'   # purple
C_SCHEMA_LIT='#E8DAEF'
C_PROM     = '#D35400'   # orange
C_GRAF     = '#2471A3'   # steel blue
C_ALERT    = '#B03A2E'   # red
C_PDUTY    = '#7B241C'   # dark red
C_SLACK    = '#1E8449'   # green

C_PRODUCE  = '#5D6D7E'
C_CONSUME  = '#2874A6'
C_DLQ_EDGE = '#E74C3C'
C_SCHEMA_E = '#A569BD'
C_MON_E    = '#ABB2B9'
C_BG       = '#FAFBFC'

# ── Drawing helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def draw_box(ax, x, y, w, h, fc, ec, lw=2.0, ls='-', z=5, rpad=0.05):
    box = FancyBboxPatch((x-w/2, y-h/2), w, h,
                         boxstyle=f"round,pad={rpad}", facecolor=fc,
                         edgecolor=ec, linewidth=lw, linestyle=ls, zorder=z)
    ax.add_patch(box)

def edge(ax, x1, y1, x2, y2, color, lw=1.0, alpha=0.5, ls='-', z=1, curve=0.0):
    """Draw an edge with an arrowhead."""
    if abs(curve) < 0.001:
        verts, codes = [(x1,y1),(x2,y2)], [Path.MOVETO, Path.LINETO]
    else:
        midx, midy = (x1+x2)/2, (y1+y2)/2
        dy = abs(y2-y1)
        cpx = midx + curve*dy
        cpy = midy - abs(curve)*dy*0.3 + curve*dy*0.6
        verts, codes = [(x1,y1),(cpx,cpy),(x2,y2)], [Path.MOVETO, Path.CURVE3, Path.CURVE3]
    path = Path(verts, codes)
    ax.add_patch(mpatches.PathPatch(path, edgecolor=color, facecolor='none',
                                     lw=lw, linestyle=ls, alpha=alpha, zorder=z))
    dx, dy = x2-x1, y2-y1
    d = np.hypot(dx, dy)
    if d < 0.001: return
    ux, uy = dx/d, dy/d
    tip = 0.01
    arr = Polygon([[x2-ux*0.025, y2-uy*0.025],
                   [x2-ux*0.038-uy*tip*0.5, y2-uy*0.038+ux*tip*0.5],
                   [x2-ux*0.038+uy*tip*0.5, y2-uy*0.038-ux*tip*0.5]],
                  facecolor=color, edgecolor='none', alpha=alpha, zorder=z)
    ax.add_patch(arr)

# ── Layout coordinates ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 6-column grid for services
svc_cols = {}
svc_list = ['svc-order', 'svc-payment', 'svc-inventory', 'svc-shipping', 'svc-notification', 'svc-analytics']
for i, sid in enumerate(svc_list):
    svc_cols[sid] = 0.07 + i * 0.172

# Two service rows — producers above Kafka, consumers below
svc_y_top = 0.895   # producer row
svc_y_bot = 0.605   # consumer row

# Which services appear in which row
prod_row = {'svc-order', 'svc-payment', 'svc-inventory', 'svc-shipping'}
cons_row = {'svc-payment', 'svc-inventory', 'svc-shipping', 'svc-notification', 'svc-analytics'}

# Kafka topics — row between the two service rows
topic_y = 0.76
topic_map = {}
topic_order = ['orders.created','orders.updated','payments.completed','payments.failed',
               'inventory.reserved','inventory.released','shipping.dispatched']
for i, tn in enumerate(topic_order):
    topic_map[tn] = 0.08 + i * 0.12

# DLQ topics
dlq_y = 0.44
dlq_map = {
    'dlq.payments':     0.242,
    'dlq.inventory':    0.414,
    'dlq.shipping':     0.586,
    'dlq.notification': 0.758,
}

# Schema Registry
sch_x, sch_y = 0.5, 1.09

# Monitoring chain
mon_y = 0.22
mon_chain = [
    ('Prometheus',    C_PROM,  '[P]',  0.065),
    ('Grafana',       C_GRAF,  '[G]',  0.22),
    ('Alertmanager',  C_ALERT, '[AM]', 0.39),
    ('PagerDuty',     C_PDUTY, '[PD]', 0.56),
    ('Slack\n#alerts',C_SLACK, '[#]',  0.73),
]
mon_pos = {}

# ── Zone backgrounds ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
for x0,y0,x1,y1,c,a in [
    (0.005, svc_y_top-0.055, 0.995, svc_y_top+0.06,  C_SVC,    0.04),
    (0.005, topic_y-0.045,   0.995, topic_y+0.045,    C_KAFKA,  0.07),
    (0.005, svc_y_bot-0.06,  0.995, svc_y_bot+0.06,   C_CONSUME,0.03),
    (0.005, dlq_y-0.04,      0.995, dlq_y+0.045,      C_DLQ,    0.04),
    (0.005, mon_y-0.035,     0.995, mon_y+0.04,       C_PROM,   0.02),
]:
    draw_box(ax, (x0+x1)/2, (y0+y1)/2, x1-x0, y1-y0, c, c, lw=0.5, alpha=c if False else 1, z=0)
    # Use a simpler approach
    rect = FancyBboxPatch((x0,y0), x1-x0, y1-y0, boxstyle="round,pad=0.005",
                          facecolor=c, edgecolor=c, linewidth=0.5, alpha=a, zorder=0)
    ax.add_patch(rect)

# ── Section labels ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
lbl_opts = dict(fontsize=8.5, fontweight='bold', fontfamily='monospace', zorder=15, alpha=0.85)
ax.text(0.008, topic_y,        'KAFKA\nTOPICS',      ha='center', va='center', color=C_KAFKA, **lbl_opts)
ax.text(0.008, svc_y_top,      'PRODUCER\nSERVICES', ha='center', va='center', color=C_SVC,   **lbl_opts)

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch, Polygon
from matplotlib.path import Path
import numpy as np
import json
import os

# ── Load data ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
with open('/app/benchmark/source_data.json') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

# ── Figure ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(36, 24), dpi=150, facecolor='#FAFBFC')
ax = fig.add_axes([0.03, 0.03, 0.94, 0.94])
ax.set_xlim(0, 1)
ax.set_ylim(0, 1)
ax.axis('off')

# ── Color palette — engineering-focused, data-dense ────────────────────────
C_SVC      = '#1B4F72'   # dark navy
C_SVC_LIT  = '#D4E6F1'
C_KAFKA    = '#0E6251'   # deep teal
C_KAFKA_LIT= '#D1F2EB'
C_DLQ      = '#922B21'   # dark red
C_DLQ_LIT  = '#FADBD8'
C_SCHEMA   = '#6C3483'   # purple
C_SCHEMA_LIT='#E8DAEF'
C_PROM     = '#D35400'   # orange
C_GRAF     = '#2471A3'   # steel blue
C_ALERT    = '#B03A2E'   # red
C_PDUTY    = '#7B241C'   # dark red
C_SLACK    = '#1E8449'   # green

C_PRODUCE  = '#5D6D7E'
C_CONSUME  = '#2874A6'
C_DLQ_EDGE = '#E74C3C'
C_SCHEMA_E = '#A569BD'
C_MON_E    = '#ABB2B9'
C_BG       = '#FAFBFC'

# ── Drawing helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def draw_box(ax, x, y, w, h, fc, ec, lw=2.0, ls='-', z=5, rpad=0.05):
    box = FancyBboxPatch((x-w/2, y-h/2), w, h,
                         boxstyle=f"round,pad={rpad}", facecolor=fc,
                         edgecolor=ec, linewidth=lw, linestyle=ls, zorder=z)
    ax.add_patch(box)

def edge(ax, x1, y1, x2, y2, color, lw=1.0, alpha=0.5, ls='-', z=1, curve=0.0):
    """Draw an edge with an arrowhead."""
    if abs(curve) < 0.001:
        verts, codes = [(x1,y1),(x2,y2)], [Path.MOVETO, Path.LINETO]
    else:
        midx, midy = (x1+x2)/2, (y1+y2)/2
        dy = abs(y2-y1)
        cpx = midx + curve*dy
        cpy = midy - abs(curve)*dy*0.3 + curve*dy*0.6
        verts, codes = [(x1,y1),(cpx,cpy),(x2,y2)], [Path.MOVETO, Path.CURVE3, Path.CURVE3]
    path = Path(verts, codes)
    ax.add_patch(mpatches.PathPatch(path, edgecolor=color, facecolor='none',
                                     lw=lw, linestyle=ls, alpha=alpha, zorder=z))
    dx, dy = x2-x1, y2-y1
    d = np.hypot(dx, dy)
    if d < 0.001: return
    ux, uy = dx/d, dy/d
    tip = 0.01
    arr = Polygon([[x2-ux*0.025, y2-uy*0.025],
                   [x2-ux*0.038-uy*tip*0.5, y2-uy*0.038+ux*tip*0.5],
                   [x2-ux*0.038+uy*tip*0.5, y2-uy*0.038-ux*tip*0.5]],
                  facecolor=color, edgecolor='none', alpha=alpha, zorder=z)
    ax.add_patch(arr)

# ── Layout coordinates ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# 6-column grid for services

for i, sid in enumerate(svc_list):
    svc_cols[sid] = 0.07 + i * 0.172

# Two service rows — producers above Kafka, consumers below

svc_y_bot = 0.605   # consumer row

cons_row = {'svc-payment', 'svc-inventory', 'svc-shipping', 'svc-notification', 'svc-analytics'}

for i, tn in enumerate(topic_order):
    topic_map[tn] = 0.08 + i * 0.12

    (0.005, topic_y-0.045,   0.995, topic_y+0.045,    C_KAFKA,  0.07),
    (0.005, svc_y_bot-0.06,  0.995, svc_y_bot+0.06,   C_CONSUME,0.03),

    (0.005, mon_y-0.035,     0.995, mon_y+0.04,       C_PROM,   0.02),
]:
    draw_box(ax, (x0+x1)/2, (y0+y1)/2, x1-x0, y1-y0, c, c, lw=0.5, alpha=c if False else 1, z=0)

    rect = FancyBboxPatch((x0,y0), x1-x0, y1-y0, boxstyle="round,pad=0.005",
                          facecolor=c, edgecolor=c, linewidth=0.5, alpha=a, zorder=0)
    ax.add_patch(rect)

# ── Section labels ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
lbl_opts = dict(fontsize=8.5, fontweight='bold', fontfamily='monospace', zorder=15, alpha=0.85)
ax.text(0.008, topic_y,        'KAFKA\nTOPICS',      ha='center', va='center', color=C_KAFKA, **lbl_opts)
ax.text(0.008, svc_y_top,      'PRODUCER\nSERVICES', ha='center', va='center', color=C_SVC,   **lbl_opts)
ax.text(0.008, svc_y_bot,      'CONSUMER\nSERVICES', ha='center', va='center', color=C_CONSUME,**lbl_opts)

ax.text(0.008, mon_y,          'MONITORING\n& ALERTING', ha='center', va='center', color=C_PROM, **lbl_opts)
ax.text(sch_x, 1.135, 'Schema Registry', ha='center', va='center', fontsize=8.5,
        fontweight='bold', color=C_SCHEMA, fontfamily='monospace', alpha=0.85, zorder=15)

# ── Title ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ax.text(0.5, 1.175, 'Event-Driven Architecture — Complete Message Flow Panorama',
        ha='center', va='center', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', color='#17202A',
        fontfamily='monospace', zorder=20)
subtitle = ('Kafka-based Microservice Communication  |  Schema Registry Avro Validation  |  '
            'Dead Letter Queues & Retry  |  Prometheus → Grafana → Alertmanager → PagerDuty / Slack')

# ── Draw Schema Registry ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
draw_box(ax, sch_x, sch_y, 0.17, 0.045, C_SCHEMA_LIT, C_SCHEMA, lw=2.8, rpad=0.06)

        fontsize=8, fontweight='bold', color=C_SCHEMA, fontfamily='monospace', zorder=10)

# ── Draw producer services ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
services = {s['id']: s for s in data['microservices']['data']}
for sid in prod_row:
    s = services[sid]
    x = svc_cols[sid]

for name, color, icon, mx in mon_chain:
